concerns.text: Phase 8 — Reporting is listed without any explicit FR or SC linkage. All functional requirements (FR‑001 – FR‑011) and success criteria (SC‑001 – SC‑009) are already covered by earlier phases; the plan should either reference an existing FR (e.g., a reporting‑or‑deliverable FR) or add a brief annotation indicating that this phase satisfies the overall reporting obligations implied by the specification.
